title: Dan Carney Has Died. He Co-Founded Pizza Hut and Then Made It Ubiquitous.
summary: The franchise with the iconic red roof began small, in a tiny brick hut in Kansas. Little more than a decade later, it was the world’s biggest pizza chain. He was 95.
